cross_source_gaps.acceptance: Public Dart client sends documented snake_case tagged input, question and instruction unions, preserves keyed calibrated answers, usage and blocked feedback, checks Google AI auth/version and cancellation with MockClient.

cross_source_gaps.acceptance: Server-side tool declarations honor defer_loading on functions and MCP; client execution round-trips discovery function calls/results; typed tool_search_call and tool_search_result including deltas preserve signatures and order in stateless history.
cross_source_gaps.status: Developer Interactions v1beta preview; Gemini 3.6+ where supported. No Dart typed tool, defer-loading, call or result coverage.

cross_source_gaps.acceptance: Test generated prompts and function results with direct URIs and inline bytes, page ranges/layers, sheet ranges/layers, audio clips and video frame layers, plus response decoding and unknown field retention.

cross_source_gaps.acceptance: Typed CRUD and persisted voice IDs in speech settings with request shape, paginated list, URI and closed-client fixtures.

cross_source_gaps.acceptance: All documented verbs, masks, pagination, auth, managed environment references and masked output covered by mocked requests.
cross_source_gaps.status: Developer v1beta create/list/get/update/delete, SDK-supported, absent from Dart. Keep write-only credentials distinct from response and exclude secret values from diagnostics.

cross_source_gaps.acceptance: Verify POST files:register with gs:// URI list, Bearer auth and optional quota project, and expose parity across conditional file resources.
cross_source_gaps.status: Developer v1 and v1beta discovery; Gemini Developer endpoint authenticates Cloud Storage rights with OAuth. No Dart files.register. JS defaults to Node credential discovery; package can accept explicit auth on supported platforms.

cross_source_gaps.acceptance: Verify ADC/Bearer auth, global and dedicated regional routes, permitted versions and backend feature availability. Avoid sending Developer-only paths to Cloud; keep vertex_ai out of scope.
cross_source_gaps.status: Separate public reference and SDK backend support. Existing config includes dedicated us/eu endpoints but global version selection and route injection require resource-specific checks.

cross_source_gaps.acceptance: Confirm each model ID used by affected examples and distinguish announced future shutdown, automatic model redirect, and existing retirement.
cross_source_gaps.scope: Deprecated models and legacy developer routes
